title: New Glowing Ores
description: Makes ores glow to make them more visible, and also adds connected outlines to them so you don't miss a single block. Mod support available
author: GridExpert

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution Non Commercial Share Alike 4.0 International

body: [A placeholder image]: https://imgur.com/HX196SW.png ![A placeholder image] ### Dependencies: This resourcepack requires additional mods which would allow textures to glow and connect. There are a few options: - **Vanilla and Forge**: Requires **[Optifine](https://optifine.net/downloads)** - **Fabric**: Requires **[Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity)** - **NeoForge**: Requires **[Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity)** and **[Sinytra Connector](https://modrinth.com/mod/connector)** ### **IMPORTANT**: **Note that if you're playing with Continuity and Sodium 0.5.X and lower, you'll also need to add [Indium](https://modrinth.com/mod/indium). It's not needed for 0.6+ versions though.** This pack makes all the ores ( including raw ore blocks and ancient debris ) glow. **There are 2 different versions of it, which names and versions are different:** - Default version ( only ores glow ) - Border Version ( borders and ores glow ) ### Mod Support: If you use Border version, you **need Conitnuity**, it won't work with **Optifine**! | Mod |Border **[Continuity only]**|Default| |--------------------------------------------------------------------|:-----:|:-----:| | [Werewolves](https://modrinth.com/mod/werewolves) | ✅ | ✅ | | [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) | ✅ | ✅ | | [Mekanism](https://modrinth.com/mod/mekanism) | ✅ | ❌ | | [Infernal Expansion](https://modrinth.com/mod/infernal-expansion) | ❌ | ✅ | | [Oh The Biomes You'll Go](https://modrinth.com/mod/biomesyougo) | ❌ | ✅ | | [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon) | ❌ | ✅ | Note: Resource pack works on basically any version higher than 1.17 in case the dependency mods are present, don't worry if it says that this pack is incompatible for this version. Curseforge Downloads
